tests.name: Rig: Select an existing route and place player at its origin

data.sql: SELECT sw.from_sector, sw.to_sector FROM sector_warps sw ORDER BY sw.from_sector, sw.to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: Move player and active ship to the route origin

data.sql: WITH moved AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{route_from} WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{mover_autopilot_player_id}) RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{route_from} WHERE player_id=@{mover_autopilot_player_id};
